candidateManifest.scope: Private host-only three-arm ground diagnostic; fixed one Lambert reflection with DISK16 visibility and cosine visible world; finite source ground occludes rays and supplies source-linear Le at primary hemisphere first hits (PRIMARY_LE)

numericContract.reference: Exact frozen PNG8 integer luma numerator / 2550000; strict threshold numerator 20000; paired 8-seed all-class consensus plus fixed 95% Student-t mean CI.
numericContract.candidate: RGB565 little-endian decoded directly to float64 R5/31, G6/63, B5/31; luma [0.2126,0.7152,0.0722], threshold 2/255; no PNG8 requantization.
numericContract.scoringDomain: Fixed source alpha8 > 0. Reference-only stable masks include inactive pixels; candidate depth does not restrict color or response.
numericContract.shapeDomain: Entire 240x135 frame. Candidate foreground is finite f32le depth; negative infinity is background.

notes: Conditional subset statuses are preserved from the frozen evaluator, not promoted to global acceptance.
Uncertain scores and pooled/per-seed full-source scores remain descriptive, never acceptance.
Empty unions and undefined metrics are null/N/A, never PASS or zero-imputed.
Candidate metadata labels identify declared provenance, while file hashes identify supplied bytes; hashes do not prove renderer fidelity.
Source alpha masks include partial-alpha boundary pixels. Ground remains in rich reference color but not in source foreground.
Reference mean intervals are pointwise and model-dependent, not simultaneous or future-render intervals.
